context.transcript:
Hi Bernard, how are you doing on developing the marketing strategies for our new line of energy drinks?
I'm just finishing the presentation slides.
I was asked to have them ready for the marketing meeting at the end of the month, right?
Right, to stay on schedule for a summertime launch.
I was planning to send you the slides to review tomorrow.
Great.
After I see them, we have to decide who should speak about which slides.
I was thinking Salma could handle anything related to social media, but you may have other ideas.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，Bernard，你为我们新系列能量饮料的营销策略开发进展如何？
我正在完成演示文稿幻灯片。
我被要求在月底的营销会议前准备好它们，对吗？
是的，为了按时进行夏季发布。
我计划明天把幻灯片发给你审阅。
太好了。
在我看了之后，我们必须决定谁要负责演讲哪些幻灯片内容。
我在想Salma可以处理所有与社交媒体相关的内容，但你可能有其他想法。
